name: log-peaking-time
description: Structured log, timing probe of peaking: event pk_stats, one record per 8 runs of Key Line pass 9 (the Key Line art filter, White peaking and colour peaking): the microseconds from before the peaking hook of the pass to after it, summed over these passes (for a colour that is the colour loop), and usGain2 of the last pass. The time between two records is 8 frame periods. Two hooks in stock bytes of pass 9 and their routines in the kernel range; no byte of the peaking code changes. Needs log-core and log-probes before it: every expect is a byte string of that build. It puts the build id fe2f543f94c74a91 of data/logdict/events.json into the block header. DEBUG builds only. See experiments/2026-11-14-focus-peaking/NOTES.md section 17 and docs/reference/logging.md.
_ram: 9 bytes of the log's state block (PST+88)

ops._note: new code, kernel range, 0xFF run: T_TICK (62 B)
new code, kernel range, 0xFF run: T_TIME0 (17 B)
new code, kernel range, 0xFF run: T_TIME0B (10 B)
hook (pk_stats): jmp T_TIME0. Key Line pass 9, `mov 2,d0` / `movbu d0,(37,a3)` (ucMode), before hook K
hook (pk_stats): jmp T_TICK. Key Line pass 9, `mov 16,d0` / `movbu d0,(36,a3)` (ucBit), after the gain is stored
flush task, block header: build id bytes 0-3 d1ddd46b -> fe2f543f (data/logdict/events.json)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 4-7 4dac2414 -> 94c74a91 (data/logdict/events.json)
